Triggered-by-notification-only offers/mini-games/events
record.description:
Ff we can somehow create “notification-only” offers/mini-games/events that can be only triggered if notifications are on. I haven’t seen anyone doing this but we know notifications are very crucial for retention. The reasons why people turn off notifications is that developers overuse/abuse it without providing clear value to the players. What if notifications are a secret gateway to some notification-only reward pathways/gameplay opportunities? I think our notification rate surely will go up (not sure how much) by certain groups/cohorts.

From [PERSON_NAME_0054]: I'm fairly certain this is achievable, because I thinks it almost works like a deep link, at least on the Android side. You know how instagram pushes you and says "so and so have posted in the first time in a long time", and if you click on it, it will direct you straight into that particular post? My big concern is that if it's notification only offers, then the reliability of that link needs to be *fail safe*, because today, I would say there is a good % of the time where the IG notifications does NOT work for me properly, and does not direct me to the appropriate location within the app. And this location is basically just a hidden location that does not have a navigational UI that leads to it. If the link doesn't work consistently, it might frustrate the players who fail to claim the offer

record.title: The rewind animation continues so long if it's used too frequent
record.description:
Version or date: ios 269

### Description: 

Drawing tile and rewinding it back and forth so much queues the animation for them. But if player want to continue playing animation blocks the gameplay because the actions taken later are also queued in all animations.  

Therefore, player cannot see the tiles drawn, tiles matched etc. because the animations of rewind can still continue. 

### Visual References:

[RPReplay_Final1730486571.MP4]([URL_51557])

### Expected Outcome: is to cancel animations of rewind when the actual game action is taken by drawing or matching any tiles. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Start a level
2. Draw a tile 
3. Rewind it quickly
4. Do the 2nd and 3rd step too much
5. Observe that the animations continue
6. Draw a tile 
7. Observe that the tile is not visible because the hand area is occupied.

record.title: Streak Bar Cinematic Implementation
record.description:
[cinematic_strake001_1.mp4]([URL_51861])

So we have the debug buttons on the side to play out the animation on the powering of the strake bar.

After we darken the screen (i've used a custom mesh for that) we animate two tiles and then the rest 3 tiles are real tiles that are clicked, then we show the bonus rewarded that goes to the character and then we clear the darkening and they can continue to play

The darkening button activates the TapPointerTutorial as well , its the hand pointing on the first tile, u will see that the first tile matching animation will desactivate that hand pointer and will activate the next one wich is for the next tile!

![image.png]([URL_51860])

The button triggers an animation parameter from the holder of the tiles animator (First5Tiles) FirstTile trigger and the other button will trigger SecondTile

![image.png]([URL_51859])

The strake power wich is activated by the button makes a visual connection between the matching tile and the strake bar above.

Because we need to display it in the UI canvas so we can show the particles above the UI bar at the top i dont know how to make the actual starting position of the dotween animation and i just put the streakPower1 and 2 around the middle of the screen, and it should be right when the tile is big in the middle, 

![image.png]([URL_51858])

The dotween of the strakePower activates as well the StreakVFX_BarFill wich is just a particle effect that shows u completed 1 bar in the strake bar. If you can activate it as well the green bar to be filled would be great!

Please remember that the third tile has keyframe animation because i needed it to flip at a specific point during the second tile animation. So to make it an actual usable tile u might need to swap it after we complete the second tile tutorial part. so user can match that one and the next two tiles under to complete the 5 streak bar. Yah we need the bar to be 5 streak 🙂 sorry.

The streakPower effect would be great to be copied on the remaining of the tiles so user can still see the connection from matching the tile to filling up the bar.

The bonus reward has a dotween path animation and for the iphone screen size it goes to the character down in the corner but unfortunatley for the Ipad resolution the character moves all the way to the left side and our last point position of the path dotween animation needs to change by code as well so it will go to the character in Ipad screen size as well :(. Just change the screen resolution to ipad and play the bonus u will see where it will land

Good luck implementing and if u have any quiestions please reach out so we can talk!

record.title: Bomb Fire Cinematic
record.description:
[cinematic_fireBomb001.mp4]([URL_51862])

We need to show how the bomb its ignited, so we have an animation the BombLvl game object and a trigger parrameter "bombIgnite"

At first we darken the background, wich is a custom mesh of a dark background so we only shade specific portion on the screen we dont need. That also activates the TapPointerTutorial game object wich is just the hand pointer on the tile.

Then when we use tap fire tile button on the right (the 3 debug buttons i did) it will hide the hand pointer game object and just triggers the animation

After the bomb is ignited we just clear the dark screen and let the game work as normal.

The demo scene is: Cinematic_FireBomb.unity and my working branch is Marcus/FireBombCinematic and i'm going to do a pr right now.

By the way i had to get this scene from [PERSON_NAME_0040] as it wasnt in the develop at that point it was an ftui stuff so if you need to integrate it you will need to reach out to her or [PERSON_NAME_0092]

Hey if you need anything please reach out!

Good luck!

[Here is the crashlytics link](https://console.firebase.google.com/u/0/project/domino-delights/crashlytics/app/ios:com.harmonygames.dominodelights/issues/c44caa0228f150e2c02c4730a5de9dc4?time=last-ninety-days&types=crash&sessionEventKey=fa50292672a549f197286c9d5b083aa9_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6032])

record.title: Quest Inıt Issue Persist on some users
record.description:
# UPDATED ISSUE

I've finally managed to repro the `quest.init` issue that actual players are facing. I wasn't recording once the issue starts but here is what I did.

* After getting the quests unlocked, I started to claim every achievements.
* At some point due to my fast clicking, the next achievement isn't populated. The achievement was `Match certain tiles`
* Normally, I was waiting for it to be refreshed by closing the quest screen but I scrolled all the way down, then the issue started to happen.


So after that here is what happens:

* The error is constantly triggered if I retry scrolling all the way down
* The achievement is lost and killing the app doesn't restore its progression
* When that happens FPS drops a lot and the game music stuttering. but I need to scroll all the way down to trigger that.

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6039]_1 (1).MP4]([URL_52012])


I saved my logs, I can send via e-mail when it's necessary. And here is my user id:

> [IDENTIFIER_12805]

---

---

The players are experiencing quest init function issue. That happens for 3 different players with hundreds of errors in the crashlytics. Since I cannot repro what they're experiencing because I cannot download the earlier google builds to repro the scenario will list the users' details here.


To sum up, the issue happens when daily or weekly quests and their chests are claimed. All of the players had experienced them in prior builds and we have no complains as of today.  Looks like they 're still playing pretty regularly. Also I didn't see any issue for the next day, all of them experienced the same day they updated the game.

1.   **[IDENTIFIER_42653]**

record.title: Silent Removal of Interstitials
record.description:
We will silently remove interstitial ads based on a tiered system tied to the player’s total lifetime value (LTV):

* **LTV > $0 but < $0.99** → No interstitial ads for **1 week**
* **LTV $0.99 – $2.99** → No interstitial ads for **1 month**
* **LTV $2.99 – $5.00** → No interstitial ads for **3 months**
* **LTV > $5.00** → Interstitial ads are **permanently removed**

This logic runs silently in the background and requires no user-facing messaging.

record.title: Event Design Update: Nate’s Treasure (Daily One-Time Event)
record.description:
**Overview:**
Nate’s Treasure will now be a **daily event** that players can complete **once per day**. The event consists of 3 sequential stages. Players must complete all 3 stages **within the same day** to earn the reward.

---

**Rules & Logic:**

1. **Daily Reset Time:**
   * The event resets **every day at 00:00 GMT**
2. **Progression Rules:**
   * Players start at **Stage 1** each day
   * Upon completing a stage, they progress to the next (Stage 2 → Stage 3)
   * **If the player fails any stage (2 or 3)**, their progress is **reset to Stage 1**
3. **Completion & Reward:**
   * Players must complete all 3 stages **in a single day**
   * **Reward must be claimed the same day** (before 00:00 GMT)
   * If not claimed before reset, progress and rewards are **forfeited**
4. **Replay Rules:**
   * Players **cannot replay** after completing Stage 3 until the event resets the next day
   * Players **cannot resume** an incomplete run the next day—must restart from Stage 1

---

**Edge Cases:**

* If a player is mid-run during the daily reset, the event force-resets to Stage 1
* Reward screen must be shown immediately upon Stage 3 completion
* Add a countdown or timer UI element indicating when the event resets

---

Let me know if you'd like a version formatted for product or engineering tickets.

record.title: Implement Rival-Priority Tier Population System for Weekly League Reset
record.description:
Revamp the current league tier population logic to prioritize real player matchups and healthy rivalry formation. Instead of each partition being filled with 1 real player and 19 bots, this system will fill top tiers with **real players grouped by rival priority**, and fall back to bots **only when necessary**. Each partition contains 20 participants.

---

**🎯 Objectives:**

* Populate higher tiers with real players wherever possible
* Group players who competed together in prior weeks to foster rivalry
* Fill only unmatched slots with bots
* Maintain a consistent partition size of 20
* Ensure fairness in promotion and demotion flow

---

**📋 Requirements:**

1. **Player Grouping by Tier:**
   * At weekly reset, classify players into tiers based on performance (promotion, stay, demotion).
   * Input: Ranked player list per tier.
   * Output: Real player pool for each tier.
2. **Rival-Priority Partitioning:**
   * For each tier, group players into partitions (size = 20) by:
     * Prioritizing those who were in the same partition last week.
     * Preferring players with similar scores or activity levels.
     * Avoiding identical groupings to keep it fresh week-to-week.
3. **Fallback to Bots:**
   * If a partition has fewer than 20 players:
     * Fill remaining slots with pre-tuned bots.
     * Match bot strength to the partition’s average.
4. **Rivalry Tracking:**
   * Maintain a simple data structure per player:

     ```
     json
     ```

     CopyEdit

     `{ "player_id": "abc123", "last_partition_id": "2025_17_9_52", "rival_ids": ["def456", "ghi789", "jkl012"] }`
   * Use this for future matchmaking preference.

record.title: Animation before interstitial Ad
record.description:
## **“We Don’t Love Ads Either” – Domino Delights**

**Scene 1: Cozy Confession (0–2s)**
**Visual:**
Sophie sits at a candle-lit wooden desk inside a cozy magical cottage. She’s holding a scroll labeled "ADS", looking slightly embarrassed but warm-hearted.
**Animation Direction:**
Sophie sighs softly, then smiles gently and looks at the viewer.
**Voiceover (Sophie):**
*"We don’t love ads either..."*
**Background Audio:** Soft ambient crackle or gentle harp pluck.

---

**Scene 2: Why It Matters (2–5s)**
**Visual:**
Sophie opens the scroll on the desk, and a magical illusion projects above it: coins transform into glowing sparkles, then into happy players joining the Domino Delights world—colorful, cheerful characters appear along a game path.
**Animation Direction:**
Sparkles travel outward like fairy dust, transitioning to new player avatars appearing.
**Voiceover (Sophie):**
*"But they help us welcome more players and grow our world!"*

---

**Scene 3: A Little Help Goes Far (5–8s)**
**Visual:**
Cut to Sophie next to a glowing potion bottle labeled “No Ads Potion – $5+ Supporters”. A red “interruptive ad” icon appears briefly, then vanishes in a puff of sparkles as Sophie gestures with her wand or hand.
**Animation Direction:**
Light magical effect (sparkle + poof) removes the ad icon. Sophie winks.
**Voiceover (Sophie):**
*"Spend just $5 lifetime and—poof! No more interruptive ads."*

---

**Scene 4: Thank You (8–10s)**

record.title: Implement Chapter-Based Ad Frequency Variants for Adjoe Users
Implement Deep Link + Campaign Tracking via Singular (Based on AppsFlyer Approach)
record.description:
**Description:**
We want to replicate the deeplink + campaign tracking setup (as described in the AppsFlyer implementation) using **Singular**. The goal is to identify the campaign source (e.g. enums like `02`, `03`) and access this information client-side for personalized behavior.

---

### ✅ **Objective**

* Track the campaign a user came from.
* Read a **custom enum value** (e.g., `02`, `03`) from the campaign.
* Access that value on the **client side** via the Singular SDK.

---

### 🔧 **Implementation Steps**

1. **Set Up Campaign Links in Singular:**
   * Create campaign links in Singular dashboard.
   * Append `custom_param` or any other sentinel value to the URL.
   * **Example URL:**

     ```
     arduino
     ```

     CopyEdit

     `[URL_52554]
2. **Enable Deep Linking in App:**
   * Implement `withDeferredDeepLinkHandler`:

     ```
     java
     ```

     CopyEdit

     `SingularConfig config = new SingularConfig(context, "API_KEY", "SECRET"); config.withDeferredDeepLinkHandler((SingularLinkParams params) -> { String deepLink = params.getDeeplink(); String passthrough = params.getPassthrough(); Map<String, String> data = params.getData(); String campaignEnum = data.get("custom_param"); // e.g., "02" }); Singular.init(config);`
3. **Track Non-Deeplink Installs (Optional):**
   * Add `withOnConversionDataSuccessCallback`:

     ```
     java
     ```

     CopyEdit

     `config.withOnConversionDataSuccessCallback(data -> { String campaign = data.get("campaign"); String customParam = data.get("custom_param"); });`
4. **Client-Side Handling:**
   * Read the `custom_param` value from either the deep link or conversion callback.
   * Use this enum to trigger specific in-game behavior or logic branches.

---

### 📌 Notes

* This applies only to **Singular-integrated builds**.
* Ensure all campaign links are structured to pass custom parameters.
* Coordinate with UA team to update tracking links accordingly.

---

This approach mirrors the AppsFlyer setup Enes described and gives us full control over user targeting and campaign segmentation on the client side.

record.title: Time Duration Based Boost System
record.description:
Current spec on time-duration based boost from MVP GDD.

## **Time Duration Boosts**

The 4 time duration boosts are purchased using gems only and are activated in the pre-level pop up dialog:

* Infinite lives
  * This can have various durations, 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, etc.
* +3 Cards to draw pile at start of the game
  * We can also have different variants, +1 cards, +3 cards, +5 cards and the duration can also vary, similar to infinite lives
* +2 Wildcards inserted into the hand at beginning of the game
  * The wild cards are inserted into the 4th and 8th position of the player's draw pile
* ~~+1 Active card slot~~
  * ~~When both active cards in hand are eligible to be matched, the priority is as follow:~~
    * ~~The card that has a “double” match (a full piece match on both halves) is prioritized.~~
    * ~~Otherwise, the older card in hand is prioritized, this means out of the 2 cards you have in your hand, the first one that entered your hand is the “older” one.~~
    * ~~In a scenario where there are 3 identical cards total, 1 on the board to be matched away, and 2 in your hand, then the older, full matched card takes priority.~~
* Infinite Rewind, player can rewind infinitely.
* If a time duration boost is activated when there already is the same identical boost active, the duration of the newly activated boost will just be added to the existing active one.
* You cannot remove any active boosts by disabling them prematurely, they can only expire naturally on its own when the timer reaches 0
* There will be 4 slots for time duration boosts
* Boosts can come in various durations: 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours, 8 hours.

record.title: Track Player Card Inventory and Sync to BigQuery
record.description:
### **Requirements:**

#### **1. Inventory Data Capture on Player Login to the backend:**

* When a player logs into the backend, capture and send the following for each card:
  * `player_id`
  * `card_id` (integer)
  * `card_level`
    * `0` = Not owned / Locked
    * `1-5` = Owned, corresponds to card level
  * `timestamp` of the login

#### **2. BigQuery Sync:**

* Send this card inventory data to **BigQuery once per day**, ideally on first login of the day.
* Each row in the table should represent a unique player–card inventory.

#### **3. Lookup Table for Card Metadata:**

* Create a **separate BigQuery table** mapping `card_id` → `card_name` (or human-readable identifier).

---

### **Data Schema:**

**Player Card Inventory Table (card_inventory):**

`player_id (string) card_id (int) card_level (int) timestamp (datetime)`

**Card Metadata Table (card_metadata) :**

`card_id (int) card_name (string)`

This will allow us to query and segment players by card ownership and progression, and support future features such as dynamic offers, A/B tests, and balancing decisions.

record.title: Zombie Ops #3 Spec (Dead Eye)
record.description:
This is the first try/win-streak-based LiveOps event, aka the zombie version of Axe Arena. The working title is Brains Aims. Some other fun names could be: Brains Aims, Aims For Brains, Skull Shot, Rot Shot, Cannon Fodder, Boom Bloom.

The visuals are minimal for this spec, essentially only an icon theme selection. The spec and infrastructure are easily copied.

![image.png]([URL_52385])

![image.png]([URL_52384])

Some brainstorm starter themes and iteration ideas:

1. Shooting board with a zombie head nailed on it by an axe (complete reuse of assets if we're on a crunch), or an arrow. 
2. An icon based on a theme: brain, cannonball, tombstone. Anything to replace the helmet of Helmet Rush.   
3. Multipliers come with evolving icons. For example, a humble cross tombstone for x1 and a full crypt for x10. Or military officer ranks based on our main hero. 
4. Are we going to tie it to a currency like in Match Factory? We can give out a currency like cannon ammunition to be a win-streak booster style shield for the cannon. Or health packs that temporarily increase the cannon's HP.
